alert.name: warden-dev-invoice-render-errors
alert.summary: Errors on the invoice render function above 5 in 5 minutes

logs: ALARM AWS/Lambda/Errors FunctionName=warden-dev-invoice-render stat=Sum period=300s threshold GreaterThanThreshold 5.0 datapoints=1/1 missing=notBreaching state=ALARM
CHANGE none on warden-dev-invoice-render in the 6 h before the alert
CONFIG lambda warden-dev-invoice-render timeout=60s memory=2048MB reserved_concurrency=none env=[INVOICE_BUCKET=warden-dev-invoices,LOG_LEVEL=INFO,RENDER_MODE=pdf] version=12 alias_live=12

logs: lambda/warden-dev-invoice-render metrics: [access denied on StartQuery] An error occurred (AccessDeniedException) when calling the StartQuery operation: User: arn:aws:sts::111122223333:assumed-role/warden-dev-platform-reader/inc-g9h-03 is not authorized to perform: logs:S
